mapper.select: SELECT enabled, providers_json, auto_apply, threshold, min_interval_seconds, max_interval_seconds FROM metadata_settings WHERE id = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_settings SET id = id WHERE id = 1

UPDATE metadata_settings SET enabled = #{enabled}, providers_json = #{providers}, auto_apply = #{autoApply}, threshold = #{threshold}, min_interval_seconds = #{minInterval}, max_interval_seconds = #{maxInterval}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE metadata_batch SET status = 'PAUSED', updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'RUNNING'
UPDATE metadata_item SET status = 'PENDING', updated_at = #{now} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM metadata_batch WHERE status IN ('RUNNING', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM metadata_batch ORDER BY created_at DESC, id LIMIT 1
SELECT id, mode, status, providers_json, auto_apply, threshold, skipped_existing, created_at, updated_at FROM metadata_batch WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_batch (id, mode, status, providers_json, auto_apply, threshold, skipped_existing, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{mode}, 'RUNNING', #{providers}, #{autoApply}, #{threshold}, #{skipped}, #{now}, #{now})
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_batch SET status = #{status}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expected}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_item (id, batch_id, song_id, fingerprint, title, artists_json, status, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{batchId}, #{songId}, #{fingerprint}, #{title}, #{artists}, 'PENDING', #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM metadata_item WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} GROUP BY status
SELECT id, batch_id, song_id, fingerprint, title, artists_json, status, candidates_json, error_message, updated_at FROM metadata_item ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT item.id,item.batch_id,item.song_id,item.fingerprint,item.title,item.artists_json,item.status,item.candidates_json,item.error_message,item.updated_at, song.source_id,song.relative_path,song.file_size,song.modified_at, meta.fingerprint AS metadata_fingerprint,meta.fields_json AS metadata_fields FROM metadata_item item LEFT JOIN media_song song ON song.id=item.song_id LEFT JOIN song_metadata meta ON meta.song_id=item.song_id
ORDER BY item.title ASC, CAST(JSON_EXTRACT(item.candidates_json,'$[0].score') AS DECIMAL(10,5)) DESC, item.updated_at DESC, item.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, batch_id, song_id, fingerprint, title, artists_json, status, candidates_json, error_message, updated_at FROM metadata_item WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_item SET status = #{status}, candidates_json = #{candidates}, error_message = #{error}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expected}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_candidate (id, song_id, fingerprint, track_json, score, fetched_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{songId}, #{fingerprint}, #{track}, #{score}, #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT id, song_id, fingerprint, track_json, score, fetched_at FROM metadata_candidate WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO song_metadata (song_id, source_id, fingerprint, track_json, fields_json, origins_json, applied_at) VALUES (#{songId}, #{sourceId}, #{fingerprint}, #{track}, #{fields}, #{origins}, #{now})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM song_metadata WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND song_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM media_song WHERE source_id = #{sourceId})
